textBlocks: TaaSFlow is a flat-fee, subscription-style engagement — not a percentage of salary. Because every search has a different scope, seniority, and volume, we quote each engagement directly rather than publish a static price sheet.
A focused engagement to fill one open position. Best for teams testing the model or hiring a single critical role.
Two to a handful of roles running in parallel. Shared intake time, one workspace, one team of the same recruiters across your searches.
Continuous hiring across teams, geographies or business units. Dedicated capacity, account structure, tailored billing and reporting.
Ranked candidates delivered to your workspace
Direct messaging with the TaaSFlow team
CV downloads and full candidate profiles
We publish exact figures only after they are approved for the current plan year.
Complete the intake or book a short consultation — no obligation.
